pinned_apps.label: Pinned applications
pinned_apps.description: Desktop-file IDs to keep on the taskbar, in order. Example: firefox or org.gnome.Nautilus.

show_unpinned_running.label: Show unpinned running apps
show_unpinned_running.description: Automatically add applications that have windows but are not pinned.

hide_stopped_pins.label: Hide stopped pinned apps
hide_stopped_pins.description: Only show a pinned launcher while it has at least one window.

app_aliases.label: Window app aliases
app_aliases.description: Map a Niri window app_id to its pinned desktop-file ID.

launch_commands.label: Custom launch commands
launch_commands.description: Map an application ID to a shell command. Apps without an override use gtk-launch.

icon_overrides.label: Icon overrides
icon_overrides.description: Map an application ID to an icon name or local image path.

label_overrides.label: Label overrides
label_overrides.description: Map an application ID to the label shown when labels are enabled.

current_output_only.label: Current monitor only
current_output_only.description: Only show windows on the monitor containing this bar. Pinned launchers remain visible.

item_width.label: Minimum item width
item_width.description: The minimum width of each application tile.

max_dots.label: Maximum dots per app
max_dots.description: Limits indicator width for apps with many windows.

poll_interval.label: Window refresh interval
poll_interval.description: How often to query Niri, in milliseconds. Lower is more responsive but uses more resources.

preview_enabled.label: Window previews on hover
preview_enabled.description: Show clickable Niri window thumbnails below a running app when it is hovered.

preview_hover_delay.label: Preview hover delay
preview_hover_delay.description: Milliseconds to wait before opening a preview.

preview_hide_delay.label: Preview close delay
preview_hide_delay.description: Milliseconds allowed for moving the pointer from the taskbar into the preview.

preview_max_windows.label: Maximum preview windows
preview_max_windows.description: Maximum number of window cards shown for one application.

preview_refresh_seconds.label: Thumbnail refresh interval
preview_refresh_seconds.description: Seconds a cached thumbnail remains fresh before Niri captures it again.
